description: This file defines the PdfOutlineCollection class, which manages a collection of PdfOutline objects within a PDF document, including methods for adding, removing, and enumerating outlines, and handling their hierarchy.

classes.name: PdfOutlineCollection
classes.description: Represents a collection of outline entries in a PDF document, supporting hierarchy and enumeration functionality.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a specified PdfOutline from the collection and its outline tree.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of outlines in the collection.

methods.name: IsReadOnly
methods.description: Indicates whether the collection is read-only (always false).

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a PdfOutline to the collection, checking destination page ownership and updating outline hierarchy.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes all outlines from the collection.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a specific PdfOutline is in the collection.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the collection's outlines into an array starting at a specified index.

methods.name: Add (overloaded)
methods.description: Creates and adds a new PdfOutline with specified properties.

methods.name: IndexOf
methods.description: Returns the index of a specific PdfOutline.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Inserts a PdfOutline at a specified index.

methods.name: RemoveAt
methods.description: Removes the outline at a specified index.

methods.name: this[]
methods.description: Gets or sets the PdfOutline at a specified index.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for iterating through the collection.

search-terms: Add method with style and color
